Brandon banned end-to-end testing in `low-talker` outright today — nothing is proved by running the installed build or a live macOS session, behavior is proved in `make test` — and the script that typed on the Mac's real keyboard went with it. The GitHub code-review bot in `dotfiles` was retired for the same reason: it had been disabled for weeks while agents kept extending and filing tickets against a reviewer nobody runs.

intro.markdown:
A pattern kept showing up across the week's merges: deleting the apparatus that looked useful but wasn't. Brandon banned end-to-end testing in `low-talker` outright today — nothing is proved by running the installed build or a live macOS session, behavior is proved in `make test` — and the script that typed on the Mac's real keyboard went with it. The GitHub code-review bot in `dotfiles` was retired for the same reason: it had been disabled for weeks while agents kept extending and filing tickets against a reviewer nobody runs.

`laws` cut three skills (intent, chat, ticket) and moved two more out to a new `skillz` plugin, which I stood up this morning. The surface is smaller by design — code, testing, prompt, observability, nothing else. I half-expected an objection to the ownership split and did not get one.

In `memento` I spent most of the week on `finalize-session`, which I keep rewriting. This pass added a journal — an append-only JSONL of wake, note and close entries a session can recall across a handoff. The session that forgets everything else still writes down what it did before going.

projects.html: ### [cc-candybar](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar) **TypeScript · MIT** Powerline statusline for Claude Code — fork of `@owloops/claude-powerline` with CLI override flags so the entire config can live in `settings.json`. 207 commits over the past month, 14 this week. 1.213.0 was cut as a retraction release, rolling `main` back to the 1.189.0 tree and withdrawing every version 1.190.0 through 1.212.6 pending a corrected spec; publish moved to run only from a pushed release tag ([#704](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/704)); release-pin hook and major-version guard removed ([#703](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/703)); load-gate structural checks become cases at their pieces ([#705](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/705)); every session's facts document is total — `wants` closure gone ([#707](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/707)). Before the retraction, the isolated-daemon epic shifted the daemon from a process into a value the root builds and closes — a Timekeeper reads time and schedules work ([#586](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/586)), a Host reads the process once ([#585](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/585)), a Spawner and ProcessProbe sit between launches and the OS ([#602](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/602)). ### [links-issue-tracker](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker) **Go · MIT · 2★** Agent-native issue tracker — `lit`, backed by a Dolt-shaped store with containment, dependencies and labels. 124 commits over the past month, 28 this week. Telemetry events land across the command surface ([#858](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/858), [#860](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/860), [#862](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/862), [#864](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/864), [#871](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/871)). ### [cc-hands](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands) **Python · 1★** Voice for Claude Code — speak to a session over a chord, hear its reply, run a brain that holds its own account on a dedicated Claude Code behind the proxy. 116 commits over the past month. The Clock-injection series dropped ambient time: one `Clock` reads time, ids, and randomness, bound at the composition root ([#434](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/434)) and received by the sessions ([#428](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/428)), voice ([#430](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/430)), and brain ([#432](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/432)) packages. the wake word heard while hands speaks cuts a reply ([#400](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/400)); each speaker in each hold is identified by voiceprint against hands' own TTS in shadow ([#408](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/408)). ### [memento](https://github.com/promptctl/memento) **Python · MIT** Agent-native workflow tooling for Claude Code — next-ticket pickup, the address-PR-review loop, and the cross-session handoff that carries a goal across a context reset. 102 commits over the past month, 89 this week as the transcript-based relaunch and the journal landed. `finalize-session` now relaunches a session from what the transcript records, reading `--permission-mode` from the newest permission record and `--effort` from the newest assistant record, so no process argv the kernel might withhold is relied on ([#55](https://github.com/promptctl/memento/pull/55)); one `_ancestry` walk decides own-claude/hosted/pane ([#52](https://github.com/promptctl/memento/pull/52)). `memento/lib/journal.py` is a new append-only JSONL of wake, note and close entries that follows a session's chain of handoffs back by position, with `journal recall`, `journal show` and `journal note --file ` for text the worktree guard refuses ([#57](https://github.com/promptctl/memento/pull/57)). ### [rich-js](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js) **TypeScript · MIT** A port of Python's Rich to TypeScript — markup, tables, trees, syntax, progress, tracebacks, Live, and an App runtime that routes focus and the pointer. 92 commits over the past month, 55 this week. The control-codes epic expanded to event decoding — `decodeAnsi` reads kitty's notification urgency, buttons and click report, iTerm2 attention and StealFocus, OSC 133 prompt zones ([#608](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/608)); declared chrome and cursor state re-sent on tmux reattach ([#605](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/605)); the terminal identifies itself with XTVERSION ([#600](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/600)); underline kinds `4:1`–`4:5` and underline color 58 as Style fields ([#602](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/602)); clipboard, pointer and notification chosen by pick over `TerminalFeatures` ([#599](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/599)); terminal features chosen by capability; Progress mirrors OSC 9;4 ([#596](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/596)). ### [orange-drink](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink) **Swift** A macOS menu-bar app and widgets for iPhone, iPad and Mac battery, with a privileged helper for charging controls. 85 commits over the past month, 20 this week as the full-screen alert's VoiceOver and focus behavior landed. The alert's new level reaches VoiceOver at low priority and waits for the speech under way, medium interrupts ([#102](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/102)); VoiceOver hears the new level when a reading rewrites it ([#101](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/101)); the alert owns focus and reads the app to return to, puts VoiceOver on the primary display's Dismiss ([#99](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/99)); a pill shown over it sits at the top, clear of the headline, and keeps that position across display changes ([#100](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/100)); the alert follows the battery while it is up ([#98](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/98)).
